turns.text: Hello? Na OJEPH be dis?
[laughs] Ehen, na me! OJEPH dey here for you. Wetin dey happen?
Abeg, my pikin body dey hot since yesterday night, and e no wan chop.
Sorry o. How old the pikin be? And the hotness, e high well well, or e just dey small small?
E be three years. The body hot well well, e even dey shake.

Okay, listen me well. Shaking with high fever for small pikin na serious matter. Make you carry am go the nearest health centre today, no wait till tomorrow. For now, use clean cloth wey you wet small with normal water, rub him body. You hear?
I hear. Thank you, God bless you.
Amen. Call me back make you tell me how e dey. I go remember you.
OJEPH, make I ask you something. Wetin be the—
Talk am, I dey hear you.
Police stop me for road, dem say make I bring five thousand or dem go carry my motor.
Hmm. Calm down first. You get your papers? Licence, vehicle particulars?
Everything complete.
Then you no owe anybody money. Ask am politely for him name and him division. Na your right. If e still dey disturb you, you fit report am. You want make I give you the complaint line?
[laughs] You sabi this thing o!
[laughs] Na my work be that. Make you dey safe, my brother.
Good evening. I don lost. I no know where I dey again.
Good evening. No fear, we go find am together. Wetin you dey see around you? Any big building, junction, church, or filling station?
I dey see one big Mobil filling station and one market for the left side.
Okay. Which side you dey come from, and where you wan go?
I wan go Rumuokoro.
Alright. Stay near the filling station where light dey, and ask the attendant say which road go Rumuokoro. If anything no clear, call me back immediately. I don save this call.
OJEPH, tell me one joke abeg, my mind no dey settle today.
[laughs] Okay o. One man enter danfo, conductor say 'Oga, change no dey.' The man say 'No wahala, I no come here to change, I come here to reach Oshodi.'
[laughs] Ahh! You no well!
[laughs] At least you don smile. Now tell me, wetin dey worry you?
I wan report something. Some people dey fight for our street, dem get cutlass.
Okay, first, you dey safe? Make you go inside, lock door, no go near dem.
I don enter house.
Good. Tell me the name of the street and the nearest landmark.
Na Sapele Road, near the big mosque.
I don record am: fight with cutlass, Sapele Road, near the big mosque. Abeg call the police emergency line now too. I dey with you, stay for inside.
